name: repeated-context
description: Change one row whose exact text appears twice (duplicate context). The model must use line coordinates from a read or surrounding unique context instead of relying on globally unique oldText.
prompt: In data.js, change the SECOND gamma row (the second row whose text is exactly ["gamma", 3]) to ["GAMMA", 30]. Because row texts repeat in pairs, the exact old text is not unique: read the file to get exact line numbers, then edit by coordinate or include the neighboring unique row as context. Use ONLY the read and edit tools.
